keyLimits.en: 1 user, up to 1,200 invoices/year, core invoicing and payment features; requires activating a Pennylane Pro account.
1 user, up to 1,200 invoices/year, adds partial invoices, commercial documents, supplier management.
1 user, up to 1,200 invoices/year, adds cash flow forecasting, expense tracking, analytics, recurring invoices.
Adds accounting module: validation workflows, financial reports, tax declarations.

cautions.en: Prices shown are HT (excl. tax) for the independent/small business pricing page; other pricing pages may apply to larger businesses.

capabilities.en: Real-time collaborative accounting shared between the business owner and their accountant.
Built-in electronic invoicing compliance included at no additional cost across all plans.
Cash flow forecasting, expense tracking and recurring invoices from the Essentiel tier.
Full accounting module (validation circuits, financial reports, tax declarations) at the Premium tier.

limitations.en: All plans are single-user and capped at 1,200 invoices/year, unsuitable for larger volumes.
The Starter plan requires activating a separate Pennylane Pro account, adding a setup step.

reason.en: French freelancer/small-business finance competitor covering banking and invoicing.
Overlaps in French SME finance and expense/invoicing management.
Cloud accounting and invoicing competitor for freelancers and small businesses.

unknowns: Whether prices differ for non-independent (larger company) tiers was not checked; only the small-business pricing page was reviewed.
